english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when evidence shows that a claim was justified or that someone was right.

examples.english: The new recording helps to vindicate him, and everyone should stop blaming him.
examples.traditional: 新嘅錄音證明佢有理，大家唔應該再鬧佢。
